501417.name: Zemianska Olča
501417.note: The notice board (live, all pages, and as archived since 2017) has okrsky documents only for the referendum 2023, NR SR 2023, the presidential and EP elections 2024 and the municipal elections of October 2026; none for this vote.

506281.name: Nemšová
506281.note: The deputy mayor's 'Určenie volebných okrskov a volebných miestností' for 21 September 2019 gives only parts and polling stations: part Nemšová 3 okrsky (1–3, all in the Kultúrne centrum), Ľuborča, Kľúčové, Trenčianska Závada 1 each; it does not say which streets of Nemšová vote in okrsok 1, 2 or 3, so the okrsky cannot be transcribed.

526291.name: Stratená
526291.note: All files of the notice board (data/uredni_deska/obsah1..360) and the election pages were checked: the only okrsky/obvody document is that of the elections of 2022 (obsah160_2); for this vote there is none. web.archive.org was unreachable (connection refused) when checked.

543497.name: Prakovce
543497.note: The site search for 'okrskov', 'okrsky', 'okrsok', 'miestností', 'volieb' lists okrsky documents only for 2017 (id=876391), 2018 (id=1011032), 2022 (id=1717407) and 2026 (id=2398726, now 404); none for this vote. The elections pages of this vote are not on the live site; the Internet Archive CDX was offline/timing out.
